message: Production acceptance test refreshed against EUROPE-EXHAUSTIVE-v2. Germany search uses the explicit mandatory 15-portal discovery baseline plus all broader source layers including BA, EURES, EURAXESS, national public employment, university/research portals, company career sites, ATS platforms, MedTech clusters, specialist recruiters and other reputable job boards/aggregators. Discovery is recall-first; publication remains strict and candidate-specific.
methodology: EUROPE-EXHAUSTIVE-v2: 15 mandatory German portal discovery baseline + all other relevant job boards/aggregators + public employment/EURES + EURAXESS + national sources + official employer/ATS + universities/research institutes + MedTech clusters + broad discovery + strict 0-years adjudication + official verification + vacancy-fingerprint deduplication + persistent rediscovery/reverification + false-negative hunt.
